selector.rationale: Osteoma best explains the hyperostotic lesion and densely calcified mass with low signal intensity on T1- and T2-weighted images, and the presence of mild patchy internal enhancement, without contradiction.

rejected.label: ParostealOsteosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of evidence for aggressive features or soft-tissue component

rejected.label: Mastoiditis
rejected.why: Mild fluid in mastoid air cells and mucosal thickening in ethmoid air cells are not sufficient to explain the primary lesion

rejected.label: Calvarial Hemangioma
rejected.why: Single supporting note and lack of characteristic features such as high signal intensity on T2-weighted images
